description: Check an IP address, domain, or URL against major global blacklists and spam databases (DNSBL/RBL sources). Returns per-source listed/clean results and an overall summary. Costs 1 blacklist credit per successful check. Use for deliverability debugging, reputation checks, and abuse triage.

sources.description: Optional comma-separated list of specific blacklist source identifiers to check instead of the full default set.

target.description: The IP address, domain, or URL to check (e.g. "192.0.2.1", "example.com", "https://example.com/page").

target_type.description: What kind of target this is. Default "auto" detects it for you.

name: check_blacklist
